reuse.why: Uses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and the shared getScheduleDate weekend helper like getUpcomingDates does; the daily-skip decision is re-coded because the tree only has it inline in getNextDate.

duplication.why: The `daily && skipWeekend && isWeekend → skip, else getScheduleDate(skipWeekend && !daily)` dispatch repeats the same inline decision in getNextDate rather than extracting a shared per-occurrence rule.

placement.why: Handler sits in server/schedules/app.ts next to getUpcomingDates and is registered like its siblings; the occurrence-adjustment rule arguably belongs in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Readable and bounded, but a change to the daily-skip rule must be repeated here and in getNextDate.
